stories.title: Russian Stocks Close Lower; MOEX Index Little Changed
stories.summary: Russian stocks closed lower in trading on Nov. 14, 2026. The benchmark MOEX Russia Index itself ended the session little changed. The report gave no reason for the gap between falling stocks and a flat index.
stories.whyItMatters: Russian equities trade mostly outside Western indexes. Moves here give a rare read on sentiment inside the country's isolated market.
whatToWatch: The next close for the MOEX Russia Index
Any sanctions or oil-price news that could move Russian equities
questions: What drove the gap between falling stocks and a flat index?

stories.title: DraftKings Director Buys $98,800 in Company Shares
stories.summary: DraftKings director Gregory Wendt bought $98,800 worth of company shares. A regulatory filing disclosed the purchase on Nov. 15, 2026.
stories.whyItMatters: Insider buying by a board member can signal director confidence in the stock. A single purchase this size does not shift the company's ownership much.
whatToWatch: Whether other DraftKings insiders make similar purchases
DraftKings' next earnings report for operating trends
questions: Was this a scheduled purchase or a discretionary one?

stories.title: Bitcoin Falls Below $64,000 as ETF Outflows Hit Seventh Day
stories.summary: Bitcoin dropped below $64,000. Spot bitcoin ETFs recorded a seventh straight day of net outflows. The extended run of redemptions points to fading demand from the funds that helped drive bitcoin's earlier rally.
stories.whyItMatters: ETF flows are a key gauge of institutional demand for bitcoin. Seven straight days of outflows suggests that demand is weakening.
whatToWatch: Whether ETF outflows extend to an eighth day
Bitcoin's price action around the $64,000 level
questions: What is driving the outflows: rate expectations, profit-taking, or risk aversion?

sources.title: Bitcoin falls below $64,000 as ETF outflows extend to seventh straight day

stories.title: FAA Investigates L3Harris Role in Nationwide Flight Outage
stories.summary: U.S. flight disruptions continued as the FAA opened a probe into L3Harris's role in a nationwide outage. The outage has disrupted air travel across the country. The exact cause is still under review.
stories.whyItMatters: A technology failure tied to a major defense and aviation contractor raises questions about the resilience of systems that run U.S. air traffic.
whatToWatch: Results of the FAA's investigation into L3Harris
Whether disruptions ease or spread to more airports
questions: What specific system or equipment failed?
Could L3Harris face liability or contract consequences?

stories.title: Air Travel Disruptions to Persist Into Sunday, Officials Say
stories.summary: Officials said air travel disruptions will continue well into Sunday. Thousands of flights are affected nationwide. The scale points to a widespread, multi-day event rather than an isolated incident.
stories.whyItMatters: Prolonged flight disruptions hit airline revenue, travel demand, and consumer spending during a high-traffic travel period.
whatToWatch: Whether disruptions clear by Sunday as officials expect
Airline updates on cancellations and rebooking
Further detail on the cause of the nationwide outage
questions: How many flights have been canceled versus delayed?
What is the root cause of the outage?

sources.title: Air travel issues to persist well into Sunday, officials say, with thousands of flights affected

stories.title: XRP Falls 10% in Broad Crypto Rout
stories.summary: XRP fell 10% as part of a broader rout across cryptocurrency markets. The report did not specify what triggered the decline.
stories.whyItMatters: XRP is among the most actively traded tokens. A double-digit drop signals risk-off sentiment spreading across crypto markets.
whatToWatch: Whether the selloff extends to other major tokens
questions: Is this tied to broader crypto market stress or news specific to XRP?
